<thought>Based on the observed molecular ion (m/z ≈ 183) and the 13C NMR data (carbonyl ~169 ppm, six aromatic carbons, an O‑CH₂ carbon at ~43 ppm and a methyl carbon at ~26 ppm), the most plausible structure is an ethyl ester of a para‑substituted benzoic acid with a methoxy group on the ring. The SMILES for ethyl 4‑methoxybenzoate is:

CCOC(=O)C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1</final_answer>
